capabilities.question: At the stable /parental-controls/ entry point, how do parents set up Kids profiles and a Parental PIN, restrict server/share/playlist/Seerr content, understand what is not filtered, and check access on each device?
How can each Apple TV system user automatically open their own remembered Plozz profile, and what stays shared or requires authorization?
Which platforms let me browse enabled libraries from several sources together and choose among copies without changing server ownership?
Do older Continue Watching or Next Up titles expire or hit an app-imposed count limit, and what server or removal rules still apply?
Which platforms actually expose letter navigation, and what are the combined-library, loading and recovery limits?
What can I open or play from Apple TV Top Shelf, and what happens when authorization or content is unavailable?
Can intro and credits skipping work without server markers, and what lookup, privacy, and availability limits apply?
How do I show two subtitle tracks, and which track types or playback paths prevent it?
How do I turn my own supported libraries into scheduled channels and check their schedule and watch-history behavior?
How do I finish and use offline downloads, including background progress, completion checks, and platform limits?
How does cross-server watch-history sync differ from profile sync and tracker scrobbling, and how can I control it?
How do I choose editions before or during playback and remember a version for later episodes?
How can an existing device help set up another one without promising that iCloud copies every server credential?
